about: EN_MalapertSummit (LOC-12) layout for the M3-8A approval sheet. Platform frame: origin at the Malapert relay summit site (sun_positions.json site malapert_summit, the highest LOLA pixel of PGDA Site23), x = local east, y = local north (away from the pole), z = up from the graded pad, metres. The frame is the scene frame rotated 2.34 deg about Z so +y is true local north.

dated_sky.earth_phase_note: Sun and Earth are 19.9 deg apart in the summit sky, so Earth is a 3 % crescent (phase angle about 160 deg): a thin bright arc, lit on the side toward the Sun

pieces.name: Legacy relay deck (2034)
pieces.note: navy steel truss deck, orange rails, ladder on the south side

pieces.name: Earth dish
pieces.note: 2.0 m parabolic reflector on an azimuth-elevation positioner; boresight 2.3 deg below level (Earth sits below the mathematical horizon from a 5 km summit)

pieces.name: Local repeater antenna
pieces.note: aims down the road chain at R3, 54.3 km away and 3.7 km lower (route_simulator_data.py pads)

pieces.name: Controller housing
pieces.note: ground level, service door on the east face toward the rover pad, controller bay, door brace, status lamps (dark / amber two unverified channels / green locked)

pieces.name: Test point
pieces.note: two shrouded sockets inside the door frame (verify zero)

pieces.name: Power isolator
pieces.note: post-mounted box, rotary handle with lock-out hasp and tag

pieces.name: L/E tuner and checksum pedestal
pieces.note: local-leg tuner (L), Earth-leg tuner with obstruction meter (E), ALO42 checksum terminal; all words are live UI

pieces.name: Solar mast and battery
pieces.note: vertical array tracking the circling polar Sun; battery cabinet at its foot feeds the isolator

pieces.name: Rover parking
pieces.note: VH_Rover parks heading west, cabin window toward the housing (S06 -> S07: the dark relay housing beyond the window)

pieces.name: Umbilical post
pieces.note: power and data to the rover; the cabin console mirrors the pedestal (S09, S10)

pieces.name: Earth viewpoint
pieces.note: low rail at the north edge; Earth just above the summit skyline

pieces.name: Perimeter markers
pieces.note: every 5 m on the pad edge, orange reflective caps

connections.south-west entry: LOC-11 relay road (final approach, up to 15 deg on the 80 m grid)

scenes: EX-CH08-S06 summit reached (cabin, dark housing beyond the window)
EX-CH08-S07 controller replacement (EVA at the housing)
EX-CH08-S08 local leg then Earth leg (pedestal)
EX-CH08-S09 ALO42 data check (pedestal and cabin console)
